civilopediaText.text: The scenario's calendar: the day of July. It is shown in the top bar next to the turn number.
July 1: turns 0-12. The night of July 1-2: turns 13-14. July 2: turns 15-30. The night of July 2-3: turns 31-32. July 3: turns 33-47.
The scenario's clock: the hour at the start of this turn, on the 24-hour clock (13 is 1 PM). It is shown in the top bar next to the turn number.
Each daylight turn is one hour, from 7 AM on July 1 and from 5 AM on July 2 and 3. Each night passes in two turns, at 11 PM and 2 AM.
1 when you have turned off the scenario's history messages, otherwise 0.
